title: Maastricht Treaty enters into force
summary: The Treaty on European Union, signed at Maastricht in the Netherlands on 7 February 1992, entered into force on 1 November 1993. It created the European Union on top of the existing European Communities, and the European Economic Community was renamed the European Community.

uncertainty.note: Entry-into-force date as stated by the European Parliament and the Council of the EU.

where.historical_name: Maastricht, Netherlands (signing place of the treaty; entry into force had no single location)

importance.justification: The treaty created the European Union and renamed the European Economic Community as the European Community, changing the framework of European integration.

reviewer_note: Place is the treaty's signing city (Maastricht), not a location of the entry into force, which took effect across member states; uncertainty_km is set to 500 to reflect that.
